scope: Read-only conditional design advice, no implementation or runtime
condition: Only if corrected orientation still fails visibility and actual submitted resource-presence is nil; nil alone does not prove absence of undocumented fallback.

recommendation.purpose: Explicit controlled cue appearance adaptation, not matching or recovering private system lighting
steps: Create one analytic constant achromatic CGImage with declared color space, alpha and fixed source radiance; no source image, texture sampling, histogram or pixel tuning. A unit linear-neutral value is a transparent design choice, not a measured lighting fact.
Generate an EnvironmentResource once per image coordinator with the public async init(equirectangular:withName:). No private resource names or bundled unknown studio asset.
Assign renderer.lighting.resource and explicitly intensityExponent=0. Preserve directional lights, CustomMaterial, camera, tone mapping, texture format and CI color conversion.

Prepare this resource before submitting any GPU frame; retain it with renderer/frame. Coalesce pending semantic requests during async preparation and publish only current revision. Fail closed on generation error.

Evaluate one fixed static image against retained live cues for visible pose/finger membership/clipping, while explicitly allowing declared shading adaptation. Do not tune a scalar until screenshots look alike.
recommendation.expectedBenefit: Adds known omnidirectional diffuse/specular illumination, reducing dependence on unspecified host environment defaults. Visibility must still be demonstrated, not promised.
limits: Unit white and exponent0 are chosen design values, not documented Apple default or factory/physical illumination.
May flatten shading or produce overly bright/specular cues; failed whole-view result is a failure, not permission for an unbounded search.
Generation latency and MainActor conversion remain prototype costs; no sustained energy claim.
No evidence yet that this addresses workout color staleness.

strongerAlternative.description: Use the same explicit public ImageBasedLightComponent and ImageBasedLightReceiverComponent on the same hand entities for both live and offscreen rendering.
strongerAlternative.tradeoff: Better controls environment-resource identity but changes live reference and adds receiver authoring. This is a separate boundary/appearance decision, unnecessary before first minimal offscreen visibility trial.

apiEvidence.claim: Public MainActor async throwing resource generation from a CGImage; available iOS18 in current SDK.
Exponent0 uses supplied intensities unchanged; other values multiply by powers of2.
Public component associating receiver with light entity.

sdkQualification: Current equirectangular:withName: initializer supports deployment18. New equirectangular:options: is iOS27+, so do not use it unguarded on owned26.4 runtime.
